notes: Product manager (Ari Chen) says: "Hosted was fast to prototype but tail latency variability and burst costs are blocking production".
Primary motivation: predictable unit economics and data isolation for customer support + analytics features.
Current hosted POC findings: average latency ok, p95 spikes during bursts ~320ms; cost for heavy embedding workloads higher than projections.
Decision: run 4-week Dedicated POC. Key success metrics: p95 < 150ms for chat; embedding throughput >= 120 qps sustained; error rate < 1%.

POC scope: Dedicated GPU pool (initially 2x A100-equivalent), canary routing with 5-10% traffic, automatic fallback to smaller model variant (quantized 8-bit) and regional failover to us-west-2 for degraded region.

Canary plan (high level): 1) Deploy model variant A (production candidate) to Dedicated pool; 2) Route 5% traffic via canary policy for 48h; 3) Monitor latency, error-rate, token cost; 4) If metrics within thresholds, ramp to 30% then 100%.

Fallback & rollback rules: auto-fallback to model variant B (smaller quantized) if p95 > 250ms for >15m or error-rate delta > 2 percentage points; region failover to secondary region with warm pool if region-specific capacity drop detected; full rollback if sustained quality regression on evaluation prompts (semantic drift) or >3 consecutive incidents.
Security asks: SSO/SAML metadata, audit log retention 13 months, KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred), and DPA in review by legal.

Operations: want console visibility at token-level, per-route tracing, and rollout timeline hooks (canary stop/rollback) in Redwood Console; also want cost forecast for steady-state Dedicated vs Hosted burst model.
Quote request: AE provided draft committed pricing table and burst policy options; finance wants modelled 12-month committed spend before signing.
Internal notes: SE to provide detailed test harness (eval prompts, synthetic load patterns) and Red Team to validate rollback triggers on synthetic failures.
use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS embedding chat and search features into product; prototypes on Hosted API, moving to Dedicated for predictable performance, cost, and data isolation. POC to validate canary rollouts, fallback to quantized variants, and multi-region failover.
poC_details: Infra: Dedicated 2x A100-equivalent (initial), ability to scale to 4x for peak sims
Traffic split: start 5% canary -> 30% -> 100% if successful
Models under test: open-70b-quant (primary), open-13b-8bit (fallback), a trimmed seq-length variant for embeddings
Metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, semantic quality on golden prompt-set, token cost per 1M tokens
Fail/rollback triggers: p95 >250ms for 15 minutes, error rate increase >2pp, semantic drop on eval-set >5%
commercial_notes: Estimated ARR range shared; customer prefers monthly committed billing with a 6-month step-up option. Asking for detailed SLOs and refund/rollback language for canary incidents.
